channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Letter: The development of the Tomoka Oaks golf course — What has changed?
item.description: What are your neighbors talking about this week?

item.title: Seabreeze custodians lend a helping hand to Beachside Elementary
item.description: On Feb. 26, after receiving a call from Beachside, a team of Seabreeze custodians came out to the elementary school to clean the school for its African-American Read-In event.

item.title: Events calendar: Head downtown for Ormond's monthly art walk, see Concordia Chicago Kapelle Choir in Palm Coast
item.description: What to do this week in Ormond Beach and Palm Coast.

item.title: New traffic signal installed at U.S. 1 and County Road 13 in Bunnell
item.description: Signal currently operating in flash mode; full activation expected within two weeks

item.title: Students are the future: Volusia County Schools celebrates successes at State of our Schools address
item.description: Superintendent Carmen Balgobin and her cabinet highlighted the district's strategic plan, focusing on how VCS is providing students with 'high levels of learning every day.'

item.title: Motorcycle passenger dies in crash on Ormond's Loop, rider in critical condition
item.description: The crash occurred after the rider failed to negotiate a curve and collided with a trailer, FHP reports.

item.title: FCSO deputy saves former Ormond City Commissioner during choking incident
item.description: Deputy Joe Oliva Jr. performed the Heimlich maneuver on Susan Persis, who said it was a 'life saving event' for her and wished to express her gratitude.

item.title: Dunn's Attic in Ormond Beach featured in Southern Living magazine
item.description: Being recognized in Southern Living is an honor, owner Wes Dunn said. It's also a form of validation that business is going in the right direction.

item.title: Volusia County Council won't pursue a charter amendment related to voluntary annexations
item.description: Chair Jeff Brower said he wanted to give voters a chance to decide if the council should have the authority to approve whether a property can be annexed into a city.

item.title: Newborn baby found buried in shallow grave at Florida Park Drive home in Palm Coast
item.description: Anne Mae Demegillo, 20, told FCSO deputies she did not know she was pregnant when she gave birth on March 5. The baby was alive when she gave birth in the toilet but Demegillo 'watched the baby die.'
